reviews.comment: I took Dr. Munson for COMM243 in the fall of 2018. He's no longer at Texas A&M, but I wanted to go back and write a review because he was a great professor. This was my favorite class in college and I thoroughly enjoyed every lecture. Hope he's doing well at DePauw!

Simply best professor at Texas A&M University. Super supportive, funny, and wholesome. Super sad I am not a comm major and cannot take more of his classes! This class helps you grow as a speaker, use it wisely.
Munson was able to take very difficult concepts and explain them in a very simple way with lectures and videos. 10/10 would recommend taking one of his courses.

Munson was an awesome prof. He ended up having to leave middle of the semester, but for the time he was my prof he was an amazing one. Super encouraging and loves getting to know his students. Hilarious and pushes you to step outside of your comfort-zone. My class missed him dearly at the end of the semester. He rocks. One of my best profs EVER
this dude is the best professor i've ever had at a&m and was very understanding when i almost failed the class and needed to redeem myself

The class is only based on 3 tests and a group video, so you do have to do pretty well on the exams. He gave extra credit opportunities for every exam, though. Attendance isn't mandatory, but his lectures are fun and make it a lot easier to learn the material. He uses tons of examples from movies which helps we well. Overall great prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Even though I, quite frankly, found the material to be boring as sin, Prof Munson helped make it engaging. Provides good study guides. The final is optional if you're satisfied with your first three exam grades, which is nice. There's a group project at the very end, but it's pretty easy. Would recommend.

Munson is an amazing prof! He puts A LOT of thought and effort into his lectures. The material is very boring and can be difficult to understand (and you need to understand it), but he does an amazing job explaining everything in a way that makes sense. 3 exams and 1 group project, so you really have to do well on the exams to get a good grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I LOVED this class. The professor is so fun and honestly so chill. There are 3 debates, 3 activities, and 3 quizzes. He is not a hard grader and the class is small so you really get to know your peers. He chooses certain debate topics and you find out if you are AFF or NEG the day of the debate. Honestly super fun class, loved every minute.

Dr. Munson is by far the best professor I have ever taken at TAMU and I'm a senior. It's a tough class and not an easy A, but you end up loving the content because of how passionate he is about the topic and teaching it. He's available outside of class and will work around your schedule. He genuinely wants you to succeed, so take him if you can!!!

One of the best professors I've ever had. Dr. Munson creates an amazing learning environment by being laid-back and relateable, while still stressing the importance of the topics we are learning. He's always light-hearted and enjoyable to be around. He also teaches like he enjoys what he does, which goes a long way in the classroom. Great Prof!

Dr. Munson is a professor that cares about his students. He wants you to do well, but you have to put in the effort on your side as well. There are three tests, an optional final, and a group video project. He also tries to make the otherwise boring course material interesting with film examples about the topic. Take him if you need COMM 301.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: DR. MUNSON IS THE BEST! He is so dang funny and easy to talk to. Feels like talking to a friend. He explains things so well and his office hours are super versatile, he is flexible around your schedule. He does not take attendance. No HW. Tests are very analytical but he gives extra credit for each one and a video project at the end of the semester

Munson is honestly one of those professors that will make you change your entire viewpoint on college, in the best way possible. I genuinely enjoyed him and his class. When someone loves what they teach the energy is contagious. I took him in Spring 2021, and as I was reaching the cusp of burnout this man and his class singlehandedly saved me.

Professor Munson is the absolute best! He is very funny and his lectures were always entertaining and easy to follow. I was really worried about this class but it ended up being one of the best classes I took. Overall, I would highly recommend you take this professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He's the best! He is always willing to discuss your grade. If you are struggling with anything talk to him and he is happy to help! TAKE HIS CLASS!

Prof Munson really works with his students. I personally had a super busy summer with lots of driving & competition related things that were in the way of some due dates. I set up a zoom call with him & he talked to me like a friend. He is completely willing to work with you to help you get a good grade.

Dr. Munson (he says you can just call him David) is a great guy. He's literally a kid with a PHD. He curses in hilarious ways in class, while also delivering the lecture in a super entertaining way. If you participate you will get an A. This is not a hard class especially with Munson as a teacher. TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Munson is a great comm teacher. I was really worried about this class because I hate public speaking, but he makes the class fun. Not only is he a good teacher, but he is also really funny and understanding.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Prof Munson makes the lectures extremely easy and fun to follow. He personalizes everything with his teaching style and while debate can be scary, he values effort. I hardly spoke up during debates and still got a very high grade every time.
david is great and worth getting to know. Very accessible and you don't need the book- he doesn't expect undergrads to read lol
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: I have him for Comm 301 at 8am. His lectures are interesting and keep you on your toes. He tries to make them fun and relatable. He is a really cool guy that gives you the tools necessary to succeed. I would go to every class and take decent notes. His tests are hard but if you go it will help a lot. Highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Munson was great! Lectures weren't mandatory but were very entertaining to go to, tests weren't too difficult, and the final was optional (would replace your lowest test grade if you did take it). There were two group projects, four discussion posts and one paper, but nothing was terribly difficult. I definitely recommend taking him!

Munson is a very smart young man, who thoroughly knows what he is talking about. Very good at teaching. I NEVER read text books, however for this class it was extremely helpful, but the book is an easy read & interesting. 4 discussion posts, 3 tests, 2 group assignments, final optional. Munson is a cool, funny, & RELATABLE. Favorite prof, TAKE HIM

Prof. Munson is great at what he does. If you are struggling with a speech or have questions for him, do not be afraid to talk to him after class or during office hours. He is easy to talk to and will provide constructive feedback for every speech. Be warned, though: he 's a difficult grader!

Take him if possible; I didn't try at all and got a B (totally deserved a C). Don't worry if you suck at public speaking, if you hit all the criteria on the grading rubric you'll get an A. He cusses on occasion. Attendance is mandatory (2-3 free skips). He judges debates frequently, so he asks really thoughtful questions during Q&A sessions.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof Munson is probably on the of the best profs in the COMM dept. I took his 301 COMM class. Even though the material is rather dense and boring, he still did his best job to create power points that were entertaining. He is more than willing to meet outside of class and was incredibly fair when grading the exams if you prove your point.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great guy and teacher! Kept the class entertained as well as made learning relatable. He does cuss quit often so if that is something you're uncomfortable with maybe stay away? Loved his class though taught me how to be a better speaker. Every now and then he comes in with a bad mood, watch out.

Munson is one of the chillest professors and honestly seems more like a fellow student than a prof. He can seem like a tough grader but is very straight forward with what he is looking for on his rubrics so the only people who get low grades on the assignments are the people who cant follow directions... tests can be tricky so read the book!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Munson is a terrific lecturer! Very interesting. A few papers, debate briefs and three debates in front of the class so be prepared for some writing and public speaking, overall very doable class but work is required.

Munson was hands down the best prof I have had at this university. He genuinely cares about his students, has amazing and interesting lectures, and even helped me on an exam review for another COMM class that I didn't understand. Munson is sincerely a really nice guy and relates to his students on a personal level. LOVE him and highly recommend.

David Munson is a good instructor that wants to see his students succeed. There is a clear outline in his syllabus stating what he wants to see in each speech and as long as you follow it and put forth the effort, you will be successful in this class. The College of Liberal Arts at TAMU only allows you to skip three classes. so no skipping.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: The class is based around your grade on 4 separate speeches. He outlines what is needed for the speech very directly and he is very helpful outside of class. If you have more than 3 unexcused absences, you will be docked an entire letter grade. If you prepare for each speech and he likes you, it should be an easy A. He's a very interesting guy.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Overall, Munson is a great professor and tries to make things easy for the students. He cares out the students and doesn't ask for the impossible. There are a lot of group projects that take up the majority of the grade, but just stay on top of things and you're good to go. He is a great professor! Take him if you have the chance.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Munson is a great professor, his lectures are actually interesting. There were 3 debates that mattered the most and he grades leniently on them as long as you speak thoughtfully and can get your point across in a group setting. If you take this class, get ready to speak a lot and convince your classmates too because extra credit depends on it.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Munson was easily one of the better professors I've had at A&M. I had him during the summer and while the class is fast paced and he asks a lot from his students, he grades fairly, is very helpful with feedback, and is very passionate about the subject. Would absolutely take another comm class to have hm again.

Class was not too bad at all. A majority of the grade is made up of the in class debates, so if you do not do too well at the writing assignments and quizzes, you can still get an A. He cares about the class and loves to joke around with the students.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: So the breakdown of grades is 3 speeches (Fact: 14%, Value: 24% & Policy: 40%) some small in class assignments (6%), 4 small essays(8%) and 4 quizzes (8%). The class is not that bad, he makes it very interesting and sometimes repeats the same concepts in different ways. If you communicate your thoughts well, you'll be fine. Also GroupMes are key!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I've never had a professor PRESENT a syllabus the way Munson did. He really knows about speeches and won't sugarcoat the way he grades. Expect to get nervous your first speech- it's normal. But Munson also tries to make everything else easy grades with peer evals, self evals, and a simple exam. Practice your speeches and entertain him? You're set.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: David Munson is absolutely my favorite instructor I have had at A&M. I am not a comm major, but if I would have taken his class sooner in my college career I would have strongly considered changing my major. He is a very insightful and intelligent person, but its understandable that some people would see him in more of a negative view than mine.

You have a quiz or a critical response (2 page paper) every week. They are really hard, but they're worth almost nothing. Then you have one speech and 3 debates. If you're not incompetent at putting your thoughts into words, you should be good. He likes people who have strong opinions. He's funny, but can be pretentious and condescending at times.
